# fudami

> fudami is a Japanese-learning project: a spaced-repetition app (FSRS) in development, and a free Japanese–English/French dictionary, jisho.

- [Home](https://fudami.net/): what fudami is and why (memory science plus the pull of a game).
- [About](https://fudami.net/about): who builds it and what it believes.
- [Pricing](https://fudami.net/pricing): planned plans; nothing is sold yet.
- [Waitlist](https://fudami.net/waitlist): leave an email to hear when the app opens.
- [Jisho dictionary](https://jisho.fudami.net/): search words in romaji, kana or kanji, browse kanji by radical; see its own llms.txt.
- [Credits](https://fudami.net/credits): open data used (JMdict, KANJIDIC2, KanjiVG, Tatoeba, JLPT lists) and licences.
- [Privacy](https://fudami.net/privacy), [Terms](https://fudami.net/terms), [Legal notice](https://fudami.net/legal).
